title: Shotgun metagenomics pipeline parameters
description: Parameter contract for the production Nextflow workflow.

spadesCoassemblyMode.description: SPAdes coassembly strategy. condition requires groupColumn and merges independently assembled groups before a single downstream branch. MEGAHIT remains global.

input.description: CSV samplesheet with sample, fastq_1, and fastq_2 columns. Mutually exclusive with sraProject.

sraProject.description: NCBI BioProject accession used to resolve and validate the explicit sraSamples cohort. Required together with sraSamples and mutually exclusive with input.

sraSamples.description: Explicit TSV of BioSample accessions selected by the user (--sra-samples). Required together with sraProject.

groupColumn.description: Categorical column propagated as meta.group. The group column is detected by default if present. Other input columns are retained in meta.metadata.

sraScratchDir.description: Optional Nextflow scratch root for SRA tasks. Declared outputs return to persistent work; only task scratch is cleaned by Nextflow.

sraMaxSize.description: Value passed to prefetch --max-size; u means unlimited after metadata validation.

sraContainer.description: Image containing SRA Toolkit 3.4.1 and pigz 2.8. Python is not used for read acquisition.

sraEmail.description: Optional contact email sent with NCBI E-utilities requests.

sraContainerOptions.description: Optional runtime container options for SRA acquisition and merging; ordinary task staging needs no external storage binds.

enableGpu.description: Internal compute-device flag. Direct Nextflow users must also select the gpu profile; the launcher --enable-gpu sets both.

gpuAccelerators.description: Exactly one accelerator is requested by each verified GPU-enabled process.

gpuContainerOptions.description: Internal runtime exposure option: Docker --gpus 1 or Apptainer/Singularity --nv.

slurmGpuGres.description: Explicit site-specific SLURM GRES value used only in the gpu profile.

gpuTelemetryInterval.description: Seconds between best-effort nvidia-smi samples inside GPU tasks.

reportsDir.description: Internal per-invocation directory for native Nextflow trace, report, timeline, and DAG artifacts.

checkm2_db.description: CheckM2 database directory or DIAMOND database file.

phylophlan_container.description: Container image containing PhyloPhlAn 3.1.1 and IQ-TREE 3.0.1.

interproscan_fingerprintscan_path.description: Optional site-provided PRINTS fingerPRINTScan executable or wrapper used by InterProScan.

interproscan_cath_resolve_hits_path.description: Optional site-provided CATH cath-resolve-hits executable used by InterProScan Gene3D.

interproscan_ps_path.description: Optional ps compatibility executable prepended to PATH for InterProScan.

spades_only_assembler.description: Run metaSPAdes with --only-assembler, skipping BayesHammer read error correction for memory-constrained environments.

sraRunInfo.description: Optional existing NCBI RunInfo CSV. Bypasses online metadata retrieval; eligibility validation remains mandatory.

sraDownloadMaxForks.description: Maximum concurrent per-run SRA acquisitions. disk_efficient uses one acquisition at a time while other stages can run.

storage_max_jobs.description: Executor queue size in the opt-in disk_efficient profile; no outputs are deleted.
